question: Nadi Utsav 2024 was inaugurated at the ______.

options.text: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Nadi Utsav 2024 was a celebration of India's rivers, held at the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) in New Delhi from September 19th to 21st, 2024. This was the fifth edition of the festival, which aims to highlight the ecological and cultural importance of rivers in Indian civilization.
